title: fix: keep the repeated-hour occurrence in hour/minute start and end

files.patch:
@@ -7,6 +7,16 @@ import type { MaybeDateInput } from "./types"
  */
 export function hourEnd(inputDate?: MaybeDateInput): Date {
   const d = date(inputDate)
+  // Shift the timestamp instead of using local setters, which pick the first
+  // occurrence of a repeated hour (DST fall-back).
+  const shifted = new Date(
+    d.getTime() +
+      ((59 - d.getMinutes()) * 60 + (59 - d.getSeconds())) * 1000 +
+      (999 - d.getMilliseconds())
+  )
+  // A sub-hour offset change (e.g. 30 min in Lord_Howe) breaks the shift.
+  if (shifted.getMinutes() === 59 && shifted.getHours() === d.getHours())
+    return shifted
   d.setMinutes(59, 59, 999)
   return d
 }

@@ -7,6 +7,15 @@ import type { MaybeDateInput } from "./types"
  */
 export function hourStart(inputDate?: MaybeDateInput): Date {
   const d = date(inputDate)
+  // Shift the timestamp instead of using local setters, which pick the first
+  // occurrence of a repeated hour (DST fall-back).
+  const shifted = new Date(
+    d.getTime() -
+      (d.getMinutes() * 60 + d.getSeconds()) * 1000 -
+      d.getMilliseconds()
+  )
+  // A sub-hour offset change (e.g. 30 min in Lord_Howe) breaks the shift.
+  if (shifted.getMinutes() === 0 && shifted.getHours() === d.getHours()) return shifted
   d.setMinutes(0, 0, 0)
   return d
 }

@@ -7,6 +7,10 @@ import type { MaybeDateInput } from "./types"
  */
 export function minuteEnd(inputDate?: MaybeDateInput): Date {
   const d = date(inputDate)
-  d.setSeconds(59, 999)
+  // Shift the timestamp instead of using local setters, which pick the first
+  // occurrence of a repeated hour (DST fall-back).
+  d.setTime(
+    d.getTime() + (59 - d.getSeconds()) * 1000 + (999 - d.getMilliseconds())
+  )
   return d
 }
